thread:
Arjun: Heads-up 1 Deckard.ai wants to run a 4-week POC. They plan to bring their own model family (deckard-13b-zen). Requirements: streaming chat, function-calls, 30k token KV sessions, and strict EU data residency + customer-managed KMS. Can we scope compatibility + timeline?
Priya: Nice. Do they have HF link or will they push weights to our S3? Also any special tokenizer?
Arjun: They will push a private S3 bundle. Tokenizer unknown. They mentioned MixRotary attention and custom layernorm.
Gabe: Custom layernorm might need compatibility shims. MixRotary = we need to confirm rotary params (base, scale) -> kernel selection. If weights + tokenizer are available we can run the ingest scanner.
Eleni: From a security point, customer-managed KMS + encryption-in-transit + audit logs are mandatory. We should add a short questionnaire: where model training data came from, whether it contains customer PHI, and retention rules.
Arjun: I'll ask Deckard for the S3 presign + the completed infosec form. They want a single contact for security callbacks.
Priya: On pricing: if they go Hosted POC -> variable routing, cheaper bursts. Dedicated reserved (3 or 6 month) -> predictable p95 and lower per-token for heavy throughput. For a 13B model, fp16 on H100 vs q4_kv delta: expect ~2x cost reduction with q4_kv but potential minor decoding latency bump.
Gabe: For 30k tokens we need to validate KV sharding and checkpointing. Large contiguous sessions may require segmented attention windows in the serving runtime; we may recommend session stitching in the app layer if memory is constrained.
OpsBot: ticket created: ONB-232911 (steps: receive weights -> tokenizer check -> compat-scan -> build q4_kv variant -> 48h dedicated canary -> security KMS signoff).
Eleni: Assign me as infosec reviewer so I can respond to their questionnaire. Also include legal for EU residency SLA language.
Priya: I'll draft the commercial term: 4-week POC + optional 6mo reserved uplift. Include a one-time onboarding fee for compatibility engineering.
Arjun: Deckard asked whether we support hot-swapping variants (fp16 <-> q4_kv) without downtime. Quick answer?
Gabe: We support model variant routing with graceful fallback, but hot swap requires a brief routing update and warmup; not instantaneous. Recommend canary then switch-over during low traffic.
Priya: Deckard also wants an example streaming payload for function-calls they can test. Can someone paste a sample curl?
Gabe: Sample below (will update model_id once variant built):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY'
  -d '{"model":"deckard-13b-zen-q4_kv","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize Q3 usage"}],"functions":[{"name":"send_report","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"email":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'
```
Arjun: Perfect. Timeline-wise can we promise initial compatibility feedback within 3 business days after weights land?
Gabe: Yes if weights + tokenizer + manifest are complete. Full canary numbers (24-48h) after variant build.
Eleni: I'll prep answers for the questionnaire and ask Deckard for certs for their KMS endpoints.
Priya: Assignments: @Gabe -> compat scan + canary ops, @Eleni -> infosec, @Priya -> pricing/commercial, @Arjun -> customer coord + weights.
Arjun: I'll request S3 link and push the questionnaire now. Thanks all :shipit:
